title: In 2087 you pay with your attention

lines.tts: [ominous, slow] In 2087, money is gone. You pay... with your attention.
lines.text: In 2087, money is gone. You pay... with your attention.

lines.tts: Nova's coffee costs thirty seconds of ads.
lines.text: Nova's coffee costs thirty seconds of ads.

lines.tts: [dry] Her rent? Four hours of scrolling a day.
lines.text: Her rent? Four hours of scrolling a day.

lines.tts: [cheerful, robotic] Thank you for your attention! Balance: zero.
lines.text: Thank you for your attention! Balance: zero.

lines.tts: Every buzz. Every ping. Every 'you won't believe this'... was a tax.
lines.text: Every buzz. Every ping. Every 'you won't believe this'... was a tax.

lines.tts: [hushed] So Nova did the one thing nobody did.
lines.text: So Nova did the one thing nobody did.

lines.tts: [warm, building] Suddenly, she had hours. She read. She built. She started something of her own.
lines.text: Suddenly, she had hours. She read. She built. She started something of her own.

lines.tts: [warm, firm] The richest people in 2087... owned their attention.
lines.text: The richest people in 2087... owned their attention.

lines.tts: [knowing, slight smile] Funny thing is... you just paid fifty seconds for this video.
lines.text: Funny thing is... you just paid fifty seconds for this video.

lines.tts: [friendly] Comment FOCUS for the free notification detox.
lines.text: Comment FOCUS for the free notification detox.
